nmosd-2015.l: Dorsal medulla or area postrema lesion

nms-criteria.l: Dopamine antagonist exposure, or dopamine agonist withdrawal, within the past 72 hours (20 points)
Hyperthermia above 100.4 F on at least two occasions, measured orally (18 points)
Mental status alteration: reduced or fluctuating level of consciousness (13 points)
Creatine kinase at least four times the upper limit of normal (10 points)

Sympathetic nervous system lability: at least two of a blood pressure rise of 25 percent or more above baseline, a swing of 20 mmHg diastolic or 25 mmHg systolic within 24 hours, diaphoresis, or urinary incontinence (10 points)
Negative work-up for infectious, toxic, metabolic and neurologic causes (7 points)
Hypermetabolism: a heart rate 25 percent or more above baseline together with a respiratory rate 50 percent or more above baseline (5 points)
